context.purpose: Drive store visits and WhatsApp orders for the linen kurta
context.caption: Handwoven linen, made to be lived in. Our linen kurta is Rs 2,499, and this festive season every kurta comes with free alterations until 31 October. Visit us on Linking Road or WhatsApp us to order.

result.headline: The carousel is close to ready with accurate facts and styling, but it completely lacks actual close-up fabric photography required by client instructions.

instructions.note: The client explicitly requested to always show fabric texture up close, but the carousel uses generic graphic patterns rather than actual fabric photography.

brand.note: Colours align with ivory, sage green, and soft gold; typography and tone are calm and refined; and the full wordmark is correctly used.

messaging.note: Messaging highlights handwoven linen craftsmanship, festive offer details, and clear call-to-action steps without hype.

facts.note: Price (Rs 2,499), offer dates (until 31 October), store address, and WhatsApp contact number match memory perfectly.

objective.note: Effectively drives both store visits and WhatsApp orders with explicit address and contact details on slide 4.

findings.title: Missing close-up product and fabric photography
findings.why: Approved memory explicitly states: 'Always show the fabric up close, our customers buy on texture.' The creative currently uses flat graphic crosshatch textures on slides 1 and 2 instead of real photography of the handwoven linen kurta fabric.
findings.fix: Replace the top graphic panels on slides 1 and 2 (or feature across slides) with high-resolution, close-up macro photographs of the actual linen kurta fabric texture.

findings.title: Slides 3 and 4 lack visual imagery
findings.why: Slides 3 and 4 drop the split layout used in slides 1 and 2, resulting in stark, text-only slides that reduce visual interest and consistency across the carousel sequence.
findings.fix: Maintain layout consistency across the carousel by incorporating subtle brand visuals or fabric detail shots in the top portion of slides 3 and 4 as well.

missing.why: The client specifically mandated close-up fabric shots because their customers purchase based on texture.

positives.point: Price of Rs 2,499 exactly matches approved product pricing.
Store address is complete and matches approved memory digit-by-digit.
Festive season offer of free alterations valid until 31 October matches approved offer memory.
Colour palette follows ivory, sage green, and soft gold guidelines without prohibited red or neon shades.
Uses the full 'Ivy & Thread' wordmark consistently as decided, avoiding the deprecated monogram.
Tone across copy and caption is calm, refined, and avoids prohibited discount jargon or all-caps shouting.

fixes: Replace the graphic texture panels with real macro close-up photography of the handwoven linen fabric.
Consider extending the visual image split across slides 3 and 4 to keep carousel sequence continuity.

context.caption: Biggest STEAL of the season!!! 40% off EVERYTHING, new arrivals included. Hurry, Navratri sale ends 12 Oct! WhatsApp +91 98200 11332 to order.

result.headline: This post directly violates almost every brand guideline, discount policy, and factual detail on file and must be completely recreated.

instructions.note: Breaks explicit prohibitions on discount caps, new arrival discounting, prohibited words, all-caps styling, colour palette, and logo usage.

brand.note: Uses red and neon green instead of ivory, sage green, and soft gold; uses the dropped I&T monogram instead of the full wordmark; lacks close-up fabric texture imagery.

messaging.note: Tone is loud and aggressive rather than calm and refined, featuring forbidden words ('STEAL', 'CHEAPEST') and excessive exclamation marks.

facts.note: The WhatsApp number is incorrect (+91 98200 11332 instead of +91 98200 11223), the kurta price is unapproved, and the sale date (12 Oct) has already passed.

objective.note: While a WhatsApp number is provided, the wrong contact details will misdirect potential orders.

findings.title: Wrong WhatsApp number
findings.why: The creative and caption display '+91 98200 11332', whereas approved memory specifies '+91 98200 11223'.
findings.fix: Update the phone number to '+91 98200 11223' in both the image and the caption.

findings.title: Unauthorised discount percentage and new arrivals discount
findings.why: The post advertises 'FLAT 40% OFF' and discounts on new arrivals ('*Up to 25% off on new arrivals' and '40% off EVERYTHING, new arrivals included'). Approved memory specifies discounts are capped at 15% on the old collection and never permitted on new arrivals.
findings.fix: Remove the 40% and 25% discounts and ensure discounts do not exceed 15% on old collections only, or promote the active festive offer of 'Free alterations on every kurta'.

findings.title: Prohibited red and neon colour palette
findings.why: The image uses a bright red background with neon green and yellow graphics/text. Memory explicitly forbids red or neon colours and restricts the palette to ivory, sage green, and soft gold.
findings.fix: Redesign the graphic using only ivory, sage green, and soft gold.

findings.title: Use of prohibited words and all-caps shouting
findings.why: The words 'CHEAPEST' and 'STEAL' are used along with full uppercase shouting and multiple exclamation marks, violating explicit client rules against these words and tone.
findings.fix: Rewrite the text in title/sentence case with calm, refined messaging, removing words like 'CHEAPEST' and 'STEAL'.

findings.title: Expired campaign date
findings.why: The creative and caption claim 'Navratri sale ends 12 Oct', but today is 22 Oct 2026, meaning this promotion has already expired.
findings.fix: Remove the expired Navratri date and align the timing with current active promotions (such as the festive offer valid till 31 Oct).

findings.title: Deprecated monogram used instead of wordmark
findings.why: The image features the 'I&T' monogram, which the client explicitly discontinued in favour of the full 'Ivy & Thread' wordmark.
findings.fix: Replace 'I&T' with the full 'Ivy & Thread' wordmark.

findings.title: Wrong price for the linen kurta
findings.why: The linen kurta is listed at 'RS 1,999', but approved memory states the linen kurta is priced at Rs 2,499.
findings.fix: Change the price to Rs 2,499 unless an approved 15% discount on an older collection item applies.

findings.title: Missing fabric texture photography
findings.why: Client instructions specify always showing fabric close-up because customers buy on texture. This creative has no photography at all.
findings.fix: Feature close-up, high-quality photography of the linen fabric texture.

missing.why: Memory dictates that fabric texture must always be shown up close.
Memory mandates using the full wordmark and retiring the monogram.

fixes: Re-do the visual design using ivory, sage green, and soft gold with close-up fabric photography.
Replace the 'I&T' monogram with the official 'Ivy & Thread' wordmark.
Remove the 40% discount, 'cheapest', and 'steal' claims; replace with approved offers (e.g., free alterations till 31 Oct or max 15% off old collection).
Update the kurta price to Rs 2,499 and remove the expired 12 Oct end date.
